items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him at Bud’s house one day.

ctx.x: Talk about your interaction with him.
This was like a one-day thing. I met him at Bud’s house one day. I knew of – his nickname used to be Bones. I knew of his – the legend of Rudy Williams. So I was

very happy to meet him. I went down to get a gig with Oscar Pettiford’s band. I went in there that day and really messed up on reading the charts. I came in there, and they had all this hard-ass music. I sat down, and I tried to get through it. Then of course Kenny Dorham and them were messing with me. “I can’t hear the alto,” and all of that. So Oscar Pettiford went to the phone and got his book out – he didn’t say anything to me – and dropped a nickel in the phone. He was talking. Then he said, “Okay, let’s go…
